title: Released vehicles
lead: Vehicles that left the daily Excel report. Record how each one left, restore one that was omitted by mistake, or archive old records.
deniedBody: You need the View removed vehicles permission to see vehicles that left the report. Ask an administrator.
loadErrorTitle: The released vehicles could not be loaded
loadError: Could not load the released vehicles.
exportError: The released vehicles could not be exported.

removedReason.listed_as_closed: Listed under closed in the Excel

truncated: Only the most recent 20,000 records are shown.
emptyBody: When a vehicle drops out of a confirmed daily Excel upload it appears here.
noMatchesBody: Change the search or clear the filters.

done.restore: Vehicle restored to the active report.
done.soft_delete: Record deleted. It can still be undeleted.
done.permanent_delete: Record erased. Its history is kept.

disposition.title: Final disposition: {asset}
disposition.body: Record how this vehicle left the workshop.
disposition.note: Leaving the Excel does not prove the repair was finished. Record what actually happened.

restore.title: Restore {asset}
restore.body: Put this vehicle back in the active workshop report.
restore.note: The release stays in the history. A restore event is added with your reason. Any recorded disposition is cleared.

archive.title: Archive {asset}
archive.body: Move this record to the archive.
archive.note: Archived records stay searchable and can be unarchived.

unarchive.title: Unarchive {asset}
unarchive.body: Move this record back to the released list.
unarchive.note: The archive stays in the history.

soft_delete.title: Delete {asset}
soft_delete.body: Hide a wrong or duplicate record.
soft_delete.note: The record is not erased. It can be undeleted and every step is in the history.

undelete.title: Undelete {asset}
undelete.body: Bring this record back to the released list.
undelete.note: The deletion stays in the history.

permanent_delete.title: Erase {asset}
permanent_delete.body: Erase this record for good. This cannot be undone.
permanent_delete.note: Only a super admin can do this. The history of the vehicle, including this erase, is kept.

reasonPlaceholder.restore: Example: Vehicle was omitted from Excel by mistake.
reasonPlaceholder.undelete: Example: Not a duplicate after all.
reasonPlaceholder.permanent_delete: Example: Test record entered by mistake.

errors.record_changed: Someone changed this vehicle while you were looking. Reload and try again.
errors.already_active: This vehicle is already in the active report, so this record cannot be restored.
errors.not_found: This vehicle could not be found. It may have been changed or you no longer have access.
errors.denied: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed.
errors.remarksRequired: Write remarks when the disposition is Other.
errors.reasonShort: Write a reason of at least {n} characters.
